sloka: अद्य प्रभृति भूमौ तु शयिष्ये अहम् तृणेषु वा ।फल मूल अशनो नित्यम् जटा चीराणि धारयन् ॥२-८८-२६॥
transliteration: adya prabhṛti bhūmau tu śayiṣye aham tṛṇeṣu vā ।phala mūla aśano nityam jaṭā cīrāṇi dhārayan ॥2-88-26॥

translations.english: From today onwards, wearing matted hair and clad in robes made of bark and living on fruits and roots, I too shall sleep on the naked ground or on grass.
